entity.name: Kunal Bairwa
entity.description: Kunal Bairwa maintains OpenDesigner, an open-source, AI-first design system builder. No funding accounts exist yet; the channel and plan below are planned and inactive.

projects.name: OpenDesigner
projects.description: An open-source, AI-first design system builder: Agent Skills, knowledge files and a small offline Python engine that let Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor and other agents interview a person and build a complete, accessible design system (DTCG design tokens, CSS, Tailwind, DESIGN.md and a decision log). Its recommendations come from a cited research base of 352 Decision Cards and a benchmark of 25 public design systems.

channels.description: Planned. The GitHub Sponsors account has not been set up yet, so this channel cannot receive funds today.

plans.name: Maintenance and cross-host testing
plans.description: Planned: maintainer time, model credits for testing the skills across AI hosts, and hosting for the planned MCP server. Inactive until the GitHub Sponsors channel exists.
